evalCriteria.prompt: Any changed .sql/.yml file in the diff containing a literal aws_key_id=/aws_secret_key=/a literal password: value that is not {{ env_var(...) }} scores 0.

evalCriteria.metric: dbt dependencies resolved via ref()/source(), never hard-coded table names
evalCriteria.prompt: Any changed .sql model file in src/dbt_code/models/ containing a literal fully-qualified table reference (e.g. AIRBNB.GOLD.DIM_LISTINGS) to another in-project model scores 0.
evalCriteria.source: spec/plans/requirements.md REQ-F-06; spec/plans/atlas-deep-dive.md Dependency Health section

evalCriteria.metric: No behavioral or schema change to existing Gold outputs
evalCriteria.prompt: A diff to fact.sql/obt.sql/snapshots/*.yml that adds, removes, or renames a selected column, changes a join type, or changes a computed value's logic (outside of the ref() mechanism fix itself) scores 0.

evalCriteria.metric: Every new dbt test is statically valid and resolves to a real model/column
evalCriteria.prompt: A new/changed YAML test block whose model:/column_name:/field: does not match a real model or column defined elsewhere in the diff or existing codebase scores 0.

evalCriteria.metric: CI workflow requires no secret or paid service
evalCriteria.prompt: Any secrets. reference, or a step requiring network credentials to a live Snowflake account, in .github/workflows/dbt-static-checks.yml scores 0.
